purpose: Static, transparent decorative overlays for the National Situation HUD. They never encode alert severity, live values, control state, or data freshness.

deliveryStandard.motion: static only; CSS may fade them in only when motion is allowed
deliveryStandard.content: no text, no numbers, no logos, no watermark
deliveryStandard.usage: decorative only; exclude from accessibility tree and do not place over readable or interactive content

assets.safePlacement: Keep the dense lower-left sector outside title, data reading and buttons; use object-position:left bottom or a clipped pseudo-element.
assets.reducedMotion: Use unchanged; it must not be rotated or swept when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.

provenance.method: OpenAI built-in image generation followed by local chroma-key alpha extraction
provenance.sourcePrompt: Restrained meteorological radar sector with partial circular sweep, azimuth ticks, contour arcs and sparse tracking points; professional weather watch desk; flat chroma-key backdrop; no text or watermarks.

assets.layer: panel background / source ledger or summary edge
assets.safePlacement: Keep the empty center free for data. Use it behind the content at top-right and bottom-left only.
assets.reducedMotion: Use unchanged; no pan, drift or animated parallax in reduced-motion mode.

provenance.method: OpenAI built-in image generation followed by local chroma-key alpha extraction
provenance.sourcePrompt: Fine synoptic isobar contours, sparse wind-flow traces and calibration dots at outer corners; sober professional weather analysis drafting; flat chroma-key backdrop; no text or watermarks.

assets.layer: panel foreground / top-right outer corner only
assets.safePlacement: Reserve an empty inner 70 percent of the canvas for content; crop to the panel corner and keep it away from controls.
assets.reducedMotion: Use unchanged; do not animate ticks, rotate the ring or pulse beacons in reduced-motion mode.

provenance.method: OpenAI built-in image generation followed by local chroma-key alpha extraction
provenance.sourcePrompt: Compact partial polar calibration ring with fine radial ticks and beacon points in the extreme top-right corner; professional meteorological instrument drafting; flat chroma-key backdrop; no text or watermarks.
